description: This file defines the SugarWidgetSubPanelGetLatestButton class, a custom widget used in the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM platform, specifically within the contracts module. It provides a UI button for retrieving the latest revision of a document, with logic to hide the button based on contract status or revision status.

classes.name: SugarWidgetSubPanelGetLatestButton
classes.description: A widget class used in the contracts module to display a button for fetching the latest document revision, extending SugarWidgetField.

methods.name: displayHeaderCell
methods.description: Returns a non-breaking space; used for header cell display in the subpanel.

methods.name: displayList
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML for the 'Get Latest Revision' button or an empty string based on contract status and revision matching conditions.
